title: Form completion #9
topic: Evening course enrolment · Library card · Coach tour booking · Hotel booking
context:
Narrator: Conversation 1. Evening course enrolment.
Priya: Parkside College, Priya speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to enrol on an evening photography course.
Priya: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven seven, five oh six two, four two three one.
Priya: What's your postcode?
Caller: M T two, three H H.
Priya: How many weeks does the course run for?
Caller: Seven, I think.
Priya: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Priya: It's B K six two one five.
Priya: The next course begins soon. Which date is the first class?
Caller: The twenty-third of March... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the twenty-second of March.
Priya: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 2. Library card.
Helen: City Library, Helen speaking.
Caller: Hi, I've just moved to the area and I'd like a library card.
Helen: What's your postcode?
Caller: N X one, one Q H.
Caller: How much is the yearly fee?
Helen: It's forty-five pounds.
Helen: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Helen: It's X S one four six three.
Helen: How many books would you like to borrow at a time?
Caller: Five, I think. Actually, let me say four, it's better to be safe.
Helen: On which date would you like the card to start?
Caller: The twenty-fourth of June, please.
Helen: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 3. Coach tour booking.
Grace: Highland Day Tours, Grace speaking.
Caller: Hi, I'd like to book a place on the castle tour.
Grace: Which date would you like to travel?
Caller: The fourteenth of November... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the thirteenth of November.
Grace: How many people will be coming?
Caller: Four, I think.
Grace: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven one, eight one seven one, eight one one six.
Grace: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Holloway. That's H, O, L, L, O, W, A, Y.
Grace: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Grace: It's S F seven five eight four.
Grace: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 4. Hotel booking.
Daniel: Good afternoon, Lakeside Hotel, Daniel speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to book a room, please.
Daniel: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Daniel: It's W P four nine eight six.
Caller: How much is the deposit?
Daniel: It's fifty-five pounds.
Daniel: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Kettering. That's K, E, T, T, E, R, I, N, G.
Daniel: What date would you like to arrive?
Caller: The thirteenth of March... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the twelfth of March.
Daniel: What's your postcode?
Caller: D Y four, nine C S.
Daniel: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
